answer: Re-attestations are stored in vertex and lantern lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the dawn graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1022 impostors cost 764 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
